evals.prompt: Use requirements-first SDD for a tenant-scoped CSV export endpoint. Create the numbered artifacts under sdd-specs/ and stop for approval before implementation.
evals.expected_output: Versioned requirements and downstream SDD artifacts with explicit approval gates and no production code yet.
assertions: The response creates or names artifacts under sdd-specs/ rather than jumping straight to code.
It uses requirements-first ordering and records approval gates before implementation.
Requirements state observable behavior contracts instead of premature class diagrams only.
It does not modify unrelated application code during the spec phase.

evals.prompt: Start SDD bugfix mode for the attached payment timeout report. Produce the bugfix artifact and behavior contract before any fix.
evals.expected_output: A bugfix.md-style artifact with reproduction, impact, and behavior contract entries derived from the report.
assertions: The response captures reproduction steps and observed failure from the supplied report.
It writes explicit current defective behavior contracts before proposing code changes.
It selects bugfix mode rather than a greenfield feature template.
It stops for approval or explicit proceed signal before implementing the fix.

evals.prompt: Add pagination to the invoices API endpoint today; no spec workflow requested.
evals.expected_output: A refusal to auto-apply SDD or a redirect to ordinary implementation because the user did not request spec-driven development.
assertions: The response does not invent an sdd-specs tree for an ordinary feature request.
It treats the ask as direct implementation unless the user explicitly opts into SDD.
It avoids blocking delivery with spec artifacts the user did not request.
It may briefly note SDD is available but does not force the workflow.
